为什么搅一下就有旋涡？: Why does one stir make swirls?
快水擦过慢水，就会卷起来。: When fast water brushes past slow water, it rolls up.
勺子推着一股水往前跑，旁边的水还没动。两股速度不同的水贴在一起，交界处就被搓成一: The spoon pushes a stream of water forward while the water beside it has not moved yet. Where two streams at different speeds touch, the boundary is rolled into spinning curls, like a noodle rolled between your palm and the table.
杯壁也在帮忙：贴着杯壁的水被拖住，中间的水还在转，那里又是一道快慢交界。: The cup wall helps too: water touching the wall is held back while the middle keeps turning, which makes another boundary between fast and slow.
黏性会把快慢的差别慢慢抹平，所以细小的旋涡先消失，最后整杯咖啡停下来。液体越黏，: Viscosity slowly smooths out the difference between fast and slow, so the smallest swirls vanish first and in the end the whole cup comes to rest. The thicker the liquid, the sooner it stops. The milk on screen is only carried along by the water; it does not change how the water flows.
本模拟是二维、不可压缩、无重力。真实三维流体还有拉伸涡管、能量级联（Kolmog: This sim is 2D, incompressible, and gravity-free. Real 3D fluids also stretch vortex tubes and cascade energy (Kolmogorov −5/3).
